import nltk
from nltk.stem import SnowballStemmer
from collections import Counter
import re

# Tokenize and clean the text
words = re.findall(r'\w+', text.lower())

# Initialize the French Snowball stemmer (the Porter stemmer only handles English)
snowball_stemmer = SnowballStemmer("french")

# Apply stemming
snowball_stems = [snowball_stemmer.stem(word) for word in words]

# Count unique stems
snowball_stem_count = Counter(snowball_stems)

# Display the most common stems and count of unique stems
print("Most common Snowball stems:", snowball_stem_count.most_common(10))
print("Unique Snowball stems count:", len(snowball_stem_count))

import spacy
from gensim.models import Word2Vec

nlp = spacy.load("fr_core_news_sm")
doc = nlp(text[:1_000_000])  # spaCy's default limit is 1,000,000 characters

# One list of lowercased alphabetic tokens per sentence
sentences = [[token.text.lower() for token in sent if token.is_alpha and not token.is_stop]
             for sent in doc.sents]
sentences = [s for s in sentences if len(s) > 2]
print(len(sentences), "sentences")

# Train Word2Vec (Skip-gram: sg=1; CBOW: sg=0) on the page
w2v = Word2Vec(sentences, vector_size=100, window=5, min_count=3, sg=1, epochs=50, seed=42)
print(len(w2v.wv), "words in the vocabulary")

for word in ["seine", "musée", "métro", "roi"]:
    if word in w2v.wv:
        print(word, "->", [w for w, _ in w2v.wv.most_similar(word, topn=5)])
